basic_info.description: Discover the potential of this charming home in San Francisco's desirable Inner Parkside neighborhood. Located on a quiet one-way street above a gentle hill, this detached single-family home offers a rare opportunity to design and personalize your dream space while enjoying peek-a-boo views of the Pacific Ocean. The classic floor plan features a bright, spacious formal living room with a wall of windows that flood the space with natural light. The adjacent formal dining room flows into a cozy eat-in kitchen with a delightful breakfast nook and lovely western outlooksperfect for morning coffee or casual meals. Two generously-sized bedrooms and a full bath complete the main level, while the lower level offers exciting expansion potential within the existing footprint. There's also two-car garage parking, ample storage, and direct access to a level backyard - ideal for gardening, relaxing, or entertaining. Enjoy the best of city living with easy access to West Portal Village, Stonestown Galleria, Stern Grove, local parks, shops, restaurants, Muni, and nearby freeway connections.
